text_block_list.name: Spectators
text_block_list.text: Wooooo!

text_block_list.name: Caster
text_block_list.text:
And the winner of the Satsuki Sho, the<n>very first
race of the Classic Triple<n>Crown, is...

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text: Pant... pant...

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
What happened in that race? And<n>what is this
feeling?
(Urk!)

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
(I still feel so overwhelmed by the<n>intensity in her
voice!)

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text: GAAAHHH! UNGH!

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text:
I'll win the next one even if it kills me!<n>Don't you
dare think you've seen<n>the last of me!

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
Is it possible for her to get<n>better—more than she
already has?

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
If she does, then next time I face off<n>against her, I'll
surely—

Biwa Hayahide returns to the waiting<n>room with a
dark expression on her<n>face.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text: Yes. I'm fine.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
This is all because I let myself<n>become arrogant... Or
maybe it means<n>there's a flaw in my equation.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
I just need to figure out what my<n>mistake was.
There must be a<n>solution to it.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text: This was the result of a simple<n>miscalculation.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
As long as I fix it, the equation should<n>produce the
appropriate results, and I<n>won't have to worry
about losing<n>ever again...

Her voice keeps getting smaller and<n>smaller until
she's nearly inaudible.

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text: Woohoo! Yeaaah!

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
Next up is the Derby! And I'm taking<n>the crown
home!

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text: I'm gonna win no matter what! Youhear me?!

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
I'm gonna be the Derby Champion!<n>Yeaaah!
Wooooo!

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
She certainly is excited... I can't<n>believe we can
hear her all the way in<n>here.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text: But I have to admit... she is good.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
Oh, sorry! Let's reanalyze things right<n>away.
There's not much time left until<n>the Derby, so we
can't waste any<n>time...

The next stop on our journey<n>together is the
second race of the<n>Classic Triple Crown tour—the
Japanese Derby.

But hearing such urgency in her voice<n>makes me
worry that something in<n>her is beginning to crack.
